verses.ar: مَنْ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّأْدِيبَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ، وَمَنْ يُبْغِضُ ٱلتَّوْبِيخَ فَهُوَ بَلِيدٌ.
verses.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof [is] brutish.
verses.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

verses.ar: ٱلصَّالِحُ يَنَالُ رِضًى مِنْ قِبَلِ ٱلرَّبِّ، أَمَّا رَجُلُ ٱلْمَكَايِدِ فَيَحْكُمُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: A good [man] obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.web: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

verses.ar: لَا يُثَبَّتُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ بِٱلشَّرِّ، أَمَّا أَصْلُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ فَلَا يَتَقَلْقَلُ.
verses.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.ar: اَلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْفَاضِلَةُ تَاجٌ لِبَعْلِهَا، أَمَّا ٱلْمُخْزِيَةُ فَكَنَخْرٍ فِي عِظَامِهِ.
verses.kjv: A virtuous woman [is] a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed [is] as rottenness in his bones.
verses.web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.ar: أَفْكَارُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ عَدْلٌ. تَدَابِيرُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ غِشٌّ.
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous [are] right: [but] the counsels of the wicked [are] deceit.
verses.web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

verses.ar: كَلَامُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ كُمُونٌ لِلدَّمِ، أَمَّا فَمُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ فَيُنَجِّيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The words of the wicked [are] to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

verses.ar: تَنْقَلِبُ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ وَلَا يَكُونُونَ، أَمَّا بَيْتُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ فَيَثْبُتُ.
verses.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and [are] not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.ar: بِحَسَبِ فِطْنَتِهِ يُحْمَدُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ، أَمَّا ٱلْمُلْتَوِي ٱلْقَلْبِ فَيَكُونُ لِلْهَوَانِ.
verses.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

verses.ar: اَلْحَقِيرُ وَلَهُ عَبْدٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَمَجِّدِ وَيُعْوِزُهُ ٱلْخُبْزُ.
verses.kjv: [He that is] despised, and hath a servant, [is] better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.web: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

verses.ar: ٱلصِّدِّيقُ يُرَاعِي نَفْسَ بَهِيمَتِهِ، أَمَّا مَرَاحِمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَقَاسِيَةٌ.
verses.kjv: A righteous [man] regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked [are] cruel.
verses.web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَشْتَغِلْ بِحَقْلِهِ يَشْبَعْ خُبْزًا، أَمَّا تَابِعُ ٱلْبَطَّالِينَ فَهُوَ عَدِيمُ ٱلْفَهْمِ.
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain [persons is] void of understanding.
verses.web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

verses.ar: اِشْتَهَى ٱلشِّرِّيرُ صَيْدَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، وَأَصْلُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ يُجْدِي.
verses.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil [men:] but the root of the righteous yieldeth [fruit].
verses.web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

verses.ar: فِي مَعْصِيَةِ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ شَرَكُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ ٱلضِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of [his] lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

verses.ar: ٱلْإِنْسَانُ يَشْبَعُ خَيْرًا مِنْ ثَمَرِ فَمِهِ، وَمُكَافَأَةُ يَدَيِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ تُرَدُّ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of [his] mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

verses.ar: طَرِيقُ ٱلْجَاهِلِ مُسْتَقِيمٌ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ، أَمَّا سَامِعُ ٱلْمَشُورَةِ فَهُوَ حَكِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel [is] wise.
verses.web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

verses.ar: غَضَبُ ٱلْجَاهِلِ يُعْرَفُ فِي يَوْمِهِ، أَمَّا سَاتِرُ ٱلْهَوَانِ فَهُوَ ذَكِيٌّ.
verses.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent [man] covereth shame.
verses.web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَتَفَوَّهْ بِٱلْحَقِّ يُظْهِرِ ٱلْعَدْلَ، وَٱلشَّاهِدُ ٱلْكَاذِبُ يُظْهِرُ غِشًّا.
verses.kjv: [He that] speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

verses.ar: يُوجَدُ مَنْ يَهْذُرُ مِثْلَ طَعْنِ ٱلسَّيْفِ، أَمَّا لِسَانُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ فَشِفَاءٌ.
verses.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise [is] health.
verses.web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

verses.ar: شَفَةُ ٱلصِّدْقِ تَثْبُتُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، وَلِسَانُ ٱلْكَذِبِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَى طَرْفَةِ ٱلْعَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue [is] but for a moment.
verses.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

verses.ar: اَلْغِشُّ فِي قَلْبِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُفَكِّرُونَ فِي ٱلشَّرِّ، أَمَّا ٱلْمُشِيرُونَ بِٱلسَّلَامِ فَلَهُمْ فَرَحٌ.
verses.kjv: Deceit [is] in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace [is] joy.
verses.web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

verses.ar: لَا يُصِيبُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ شَرٌّ، أَمَّا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ فَيَمْتَلِئُونَ سُوءًا.
verses.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

verses.ar: كَرَاهَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ شَفَتَا كَذِبٍ، أَمَّا ٱلْعَامِلُونَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ فَرِضَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Lying lips [are] abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly [are] his delight.
verses.web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلذَّكِيُّ يَسْتُرُ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ، وَقَلْبُ ٱلْجَاهِلِ يُنَادِي بِٱلْحَمَقِ.
verses.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

verses.ar: يَدُ ٱلْمُجْتَهِدِينَ تَسُودُ، أَمَّا ٱلرَّخْوَةُ فَتَكُونُ تَحْتَ ٱلْجِزْيَةِ.
verses.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

verses.ar: ٱلْغَمُّ فِي قَلْبِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يُحْنِيهِ، وَٱلْكَلِمَةُ ٱلطَّيِّبَةُ تُفَرِّحُهُ.
verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

verses.ar: ٱلصِّدِّيقُ يَهْدِي صَاحِبَهُ، أَمَّا طَرِيقُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَتُضِلُّهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The righteous [is] more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّخَاوَةُ لَا تَمْسِكُ صَيْدًا، أَمَّا ثَرْوَةُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلْكَرِيمَةُ فَهِيَ الِٱجْتِهَادُ.
verses.kjv: The slothful [man] roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man [is] precious.
verses.web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

verses.ar: فِي سَبِيلِ ٱلْبِرِّ حَيَاةٌ، وَفِي طَرِيقِ مَسْلِكِهِ لَا مَوْتَ.
verses.kjv: In the way of righteousness [is] life; and [in] the pathway [thereof there is] no death.
verses.web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
